title: Sculptor Chester Beach's Brewster estate 'OldWalls' hits market for $4.15M
summary_full: OldWalls, a historic estate in Brewster, New York, is now available for $4.15 million. This 10.49-acre property features a main house with eight bedrooms and six and a half bathrooms. The estate was originally built by sculptor Chester Beach and has been carefully maintained over the years. It includes multiple buildings and amenities suitable for equestrian use. Potential buyers are those seeking privacy while remaining close to New York City.
